ui.legal.storage: Neko Aurora runs on a server you operate, or on a shared server in multi-user mode. Each account has a separate workspace and a secret store encrypted with its own account key. Your messages, bots, history and connections are stored on that server, not on the developer’s server.
ui.legal.ai: AI models: conversation content is sent to the model provider you configure (z.ai by default) to generate replies.
ui.legal.tools: Lookup tools: when data is needed, your server queries allowlisted public sources, such as gold prices and web search. These queries do not include personal information.
ui.legal.outbound: Mail and posts: nothing is sent externally until you select Approve.
ui.legal.push: Push notifications: device tokens (APNs/Web Push) are used only to notify you when a bot needs your attention.
ui.legal.secrets: API keys and app passwords are encrypted with AES-GCM in the server’s secret store. They are never displayed again or included in model prompts.
ui.legal.tracking: No advertising, cross-app tracking or third-party analytics SDKs.
ui.legal.delete: You can archive individual bots in the app, delete individual secrets in Connections, or go to Settings → Delete account & data (type XOÁ or DELETE to confirm) to permanently erase all bots, messages, secrets, connections and backups.
ui.legal.service: Neko Aurora is a personal assistant app. Bots draft, research and propose actions; every outbound action requires your approval.
ui.legal.aiTerms: Replies can be wrong. Figures include sources; assessments are opinions, not financial, legal or medical advice.
ui.legal.responsibility: You are responsible for what you approve for sending, the third-party accounts you connect, and complying with those providers’ terms.
ui.legal.warranty: The software is provided “as is”, without any warranty to the extent permitted by law.
